observations: Photo 0 shows a wall split air conditioner, uninstalled: the indoor unit is resting on top of the outdoor unit on a tiled floor by a door.
The outdoor unit carries a faded red logo that reads as 'SANYO' and the word 'inverter' below it.
The indoor unit is yellowed and dirty, with grime on the louvres and small rating stickers whose text cannot be read.
The outdoor unit has rust marks and stains on the casing and fan grille; the cut pipe and cable ends hang from its side.
No rating plate is readable, so the model and the horsepower are not shown.
No remote control, no copper pipe set and no power-on view are shown.
The seller's own words call it 'Faulty' and also 'works perfectly', 'like new'.

identity.kind: faulty inverter split air conditioner, indoor and outdoor unit
read_from: photo 0 faded red logo 'SANYO' and 'inverter' on the outdoor unit

claims.evidence: Photo 0 'inverter' on the outdoor unit; the unit is uninstalled and worn, consistent with a faulty unit. The fault itself is not shown.
Photo 0 shows a yellowed, dirty indoor unit and a stained, rust-marked outdoor unit.
Repair history cannot be seen in a photo.
The seller's own listing says 'Faulty'; no power-on or cooling clip is shown.
No receipt or warranty is shown, and the unit's age and wear in photo 0 make a running warranty unlikely.

risks.risk: The fault may be a dead compressor or a burnt inverter control board, leaving only scrap or parts value.
risks.proof: A photo of the fault code on the indoor display or a technician's written diagnosis, plus a clip of the outdoor unit powered on.
risks.if_unproven: as not working, scrap and parts value

risks.risk: Horsepower unknown, which sets the copper and parts value.
risks.proof: A close photo of the rating plate on the side of the outdoor unit and on the indoor unit.

risks.risk: The compressor, copper coils or control boards may already have been removed from inside the casings.
risks.proof: A photo with the outdoor unit side panel off, showing the compressor and coil in place.
risks.if_unproven: as an empty casing with missing parts

risks.risk: Remote control and pipe set missing.
risks.proof: A photo of the remote and copper pipe set beside the units.

proof_requests: A close photo of the rating plate on the outdoor unit showing model and horsepower.
A photo with the outdoor unit side panel removed, showing the compressor and coils inside.
A photo of the fault code or a technician's diagnosis note.
A photo of the receipt and warranty if they exist, with a handwritten note carrying today's date.
response.reason: The kind is clear from photo 0 and the seller says it is faulty, so it is priced at its worst case as a faulty, not working, smallest-size split unit for parts; the 'works perfectly' and 'like new' lines are contradicted by the listing's own word and the photo and add nothing.
